solutions_index.intro_heading: What we mean by a solution
solutions_index.intro_body: A solution is the whole measuring chain delivered as one system: the load cells and sensors on your structure, the edge gateway that reads them, the installation and calibration, and the cloud dashboard that turns raw readings into alerts. We specify each system against your own site rather than selling you a part to fit yourself. The individual components are listed under Products.
solutions_index.choose_sub: The three systems differ in what they measure, not in how they are run.
solutions_index.choose[0].name: SensWEIGHT® Bridge
solutions_index.choose[0].when: Choose this if you weigh something that moves — trucks across a weighbridge, loads leaving a pit, batches into a mixer.
solutions_index.choose[0].what: It reads up to 8 load cells in real time and watches each one for drift, failure and tampering, so a failing cell is found instead of quietly costing you money for months. The diagnostic method is covered by European patent EP 4 524 526.
solutions_index.choose[1].name: SensSILO
solutions_index.choose[1].when: Choose this if you need to know how much is in a silo, tank or container without sending someone to dip it.
solutions_index.choose[1].what: It measures the stored mass continuously and raises fill and low-stock alerts, replacing a reading taken by hand once a shift with a figure that is always current.
solutions_index.choose[2].name: SensBELT
solutions_index.choose[2].when: Choose this if the material travels on a conveyor and you bill, budget or reconcile from belt-scale totals.
solutions_index.choose[2].what: It measures continuous gravimetric flow, with empty-belt detection and a running calibration check. SensBELT is part of the SensWEIGHT® platform rather than a separate system, so it shares the same dashboard.
solutions_index.shared_body: One dashboard, one alerting model and one set of reports, whichever system you run. We engineer, install and commission the hardware ourselves, and any of the three can be tried on a free 30-day pilot — we lend you the system for a month at no cost.

industries.items.beltscale.headline: Stop paying for air on your conveyor.
industries.items.beltscale.sub: Your belt can't tell 500 tonnes an hour from zero. Your electricity bill can.
industries.items.beltscale.story.problem: The most expensive machine that does nothing
You wouldn't leave your car engine running all night in the car park. Your belt does exactly that, every day.
The belt keeps running after the last truck dumps — nobody notices for 45 minutes, 3–4 times per shift.
A 75 kW drive running empty 3 h/day × 320 days × €0.18/kWh = €12,960 a year wasted.
Accelerated belt and roller wear: another €21,600 a year.
No way to check the belt scale is still accurate without a site visit.
Empty belt detected automatically — shutdown signal after 5 minutes.
Calibration drift tracked continuously — no technician visits needed.
industries.items.beltscale.story.evidenc: A quarry found 847 hours of ghost running a year
A medium-size aggregate quarry, two belt scales feeding a crusher. Operators assumed the belts only ran while trucks were dumping — the control room saw ON/OFF status, not load.

SensBELT found Belt #1 running empty for 2.65 hours a day on average: 847 hours a year and €11,430 of wasted energy — plus 14 months of extra wear, bringing a €38,000 belt replacement forward by 14 months.
The fix: automatic idle shutdown — no load for 5 minutes sends a stop signal to the drive. Ghost running dropped to near zero by week 2.
industries.items.beltscale.story.connect: No belt stoppage, no recalibration. One device, one cable.
One device connects to the indicator's RS-232/485 port. No belt stoppage, no recalibration.
The UCS X3 gateway sends data over a secure wireless link. Optional extra sensors: temperature, vibration.
Live throughput, empty-belt detection, calibration-drift alerts and energy analytics — from any device, with automatic alerts and a REST API.
Is your belt scale still accurate?
Your indicator says 342 t/h. But is it? SensBELT checks continuously — so you don't have to send a technician to find out.
Does the belt read 0 when it's empty?
Is the full-scale reading still correct?
Is a load cell starting to degrade?

Today's readings are compared with your historical baseline, so you're alerted 4–6 weeks before accuracy drifts out of tolerance — for example: “LC2 will exceed ±0.5% in about 6 weeks. Schedule calibration.”
industries.items.beltscale.story.math.su: One unnecessary technician visit costs €142; the system runs €59–99 a month. Avoiding a single wasted trip pays for it — everything else is profit.
industries.items.beltscale.story.pilot.h: Prove it on your busiest conveyor
industries.items.beltscale.story.pilot.b: A free 30-day pilot on your most-used belt — we lend you the system for a month at no cost. If we don't find wasted hours — walk away.
industries.items.beltscale.story.pilot.p: Automatic empty-belt detection and energy savings from day one.
Continuous calibration checks without site visits — know when accuracy drifts, not after it's too late.
Fewer empty running hours, less wear. Your €38,000 belt replacement should come on schedule, not 14 months early.

sensweight.hero_sub: 10,000 tonnes a month across your scale. Even 1% drift means 100 tonnes given away for free.
sensweight.story.problem.heading: The error you can't see on your indicator
sensweight.story.problem.lead: The scale shows a number. It just shows the wrong number.
sensweight.story.problem.without[0]: The indicator shows 42,410 kg — it looks right, so the operator prints the ticket.
sensweight.story.problem.without[1]: Underneath, one load cell is 44.6% off its theoretical value — invisible to the operator.
sensweight.story.problem.without[2]: Annual calibration passed — but degradation happens between checks.
sensweight.story.problem.without[3]: 2% drift on 10,000 t/month at €50/t = €120,000 a year in undetected losses.
sensweight.story.problem.with[0]: Per-load-cell health on every weighment — verified at cell level.
sensweight.story.problem.with[1]: Deviation detected instantly, not at the next annual calibration.
sensweight.story.problem.with[2]: Vehicle positioning verified — partial-weighing fraud caught.
sensweight.story.problem.with[3]: Revenue tracked per transaction — your scale becomes a cash register.
sensweight.story.evidence.heading: One load cell was wrong for 5 months — and nobody knew
sensweight.story.evidence.paragraphs[0]: A busy truck scale at an agricultural depot: an 18 × 3 m deck, annual calibration passed, indicator working, no complaints.
sensweight.story.evidence.paragraphs[1]: SensWEIGHT® found load cell 8 reporting only 971 kg against an expected ~3,500 kg. The indicator's total compensated across the other cells and masked the problem — inbound grain deliveries were systematically underweighed, so farmers delivered more than they were credited for.
sensweight.story.evidence.paragraphs[2]: The fix: one replacement load cell (€380) and repositioned vehicle guidance markers.

sensweight.pitch_body: SensWEIGHT is a remote weighing monitor that continuously diagnoses the health of your weighbridge or belt scale — reading up to 8 load cells in real time to catch drift, imbalance, and failure before they cost you. Think of it as continuous vital-sign monitoring for your weighing equipment: instead of waiting for an annual calibration "check-up" to catch a problem after it's already cost you money, SensWEIGHT reads every load cell's micro-voltage signal around the clock, flagging the earliest signs of trouble — the same way a heart monitor catches an irregularity long before it becomes an emergency.

senssilo.pitch_body: SensSILO is a remote silo and hopper monitor that tracks your material reserves the way a continuous glucose monitor tracks blood sugar — constantly, automatically, without anyone climbing a ladder to take a manual reading.
